label: Ischemic Stroke as the First Manifestation of Takayasu Arteritis: A Case Report.
summary: Ischemic stroke in young adults is uncommon and is frequently associated with rare etiologies, including autoimmune diseases and vasculitis. Takayasu arteritis (TA) is a chronic inflammatory large-vessel arteriopathy involving the aorta and its major branches and may result in cerebral ischemia due to arterial stenosis or thrombosis.
